accuracyIssues.title: Illustrative plan, not a real home
accuracyIssues.detail: An illustrative senior-friendly plan informed by typical Alhambra and San Gabriel Valley 2-bed listings (Redfin, Homes.com, Zillow; 800-1,400 sq ft bungalows and ranches) and by 2010 ADA Standards / ICC A117.1 Type A dwelling-unit guidance. It is enlarged 15-25 % over a typical 2/1 listing where wheelchair and walker clearances need it. No participant records, address or survey are used; listing pages served as inspiration only (WebFetch was blocked, values come from search summaries).

accuracyIssues.title: Accessibility values are interpretations
accuracyIssues.detail: Door clear widths (0.90 m interior, 1.00 m exterior), the 1.18 m hall, seven 1.5 m turning circles, the toilet clearance (centreline 0.45 m, 1.525 x 1.42 m), the 1.55 x 1.45 m roll-in shower, the 0.76 m seated worktop and the grab-bar layout follow ADA 304, 404, 604, 608, 609 and ICC A117.1 as interpreted for a dwelling; the care-shower asset's bar layout differs slightly from ADA 608.3.2. Checked by scripts/validate-home.mjs, not by an accessibility consultant.

accuracyIssues.title: Door gaps aligned to the navigation grid
accuracyIssues.detail: Interior door gaps were shifted by up to 0.08 m from the study so that their centres fall on the 0.2 m navigation grid: a 0.9 m door passes a wheelchair (0.37 m clearance) only when a grid line runs through its middle. Clear widths are unchanged.

accuracyIssues.title: Fittings shown in their end state
accuracyIssues.detail: The swing-up grab bar and the bed transfer handle are fitted by the installer during the simulated day (1:14-1:53 PM) but the static plan shows them installed.

accuracyIssues.title: Roof and windows not modelled as geometry
accuracyIssues.detail: The pitched roof (ridge along z at x = -1.3, eave 2.45 m, rise about 1.9 m, shed roof over the porch) and the windows are recorded in roofNote and windowSchedule only; the community instance is a cutaway and draws neither.

accuracyIssues.title: Morning independence is an assumption
accuracyIssues.detail: Mrs. Wong toilets, washes and dresses her top half on her own before the aide arrives at 8:28. This is an illustrative composite of what the accessible bath enables; in another care plan the aide could start at 8:00.
